description: Implementation of ScenicWindow class for Fuchsia platform, managing scenic view creation, native window handling, and service connections.

classes.name: ScenicWindow

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up scenic resources, creates view, and initializes native window.

methods.name: getNativeWindow
